preToolUse.bash: o=$(dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-tool --harness github); s=$?; if [ $s -eq 0 ] || [ $s -eq 2 ]; then [ -z "$o" ] || printf '%s\n' "$o"; exit $s; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The agent gate hook could not run, so this edit is blocked. That is a setup problem on this machine, not a fault in your work. Run dotnet --version from the project root to see the error, then follow If An Agent Gate Hook Itself Fails in the module-building workflow instructions. Do not make the edit another way."}'; exit 2
preToolUse.powershell: $o = dotnet run .github/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-tool --harness github; $s = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($s -eq 0 -or $s -eq 2) { $o; exit $s }; @{ permissionDecision = 'deny'; permissionDecisionReason = 'The agent gate hook could not run, so this edit is blocked. That is a setup problem on this machine, not a fault in your work. Run dotnet --version from the project root to see the error, then follow If An Agent Gate Hook Itself Fails in the module-building workflow instructions. Do not make the edit another way.' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 2
